feeds.title: Ladima Foundation
feeds.description: Get to know the stories and latest news from the Ladima Foundation. The Ladima Foundation is a proudly Pan-African, woman-only focused film and content industry initiative, founded and led by African women. As leaders in our industry, we aim to train, build capacity, recognise, promote, and develop women within Africa's unique film, TV, and content spaces.

feeds.title: European Film Academy
feeds.description: The European Film Academy seeks to support and connect its 4,000 members and celebrates and promotes their work. Its aims are to share knowledge and to educate audiences of all ages about European cinema.

feeds.title: Central Film School
feeds.description: In our latest news, you will find alumni showcases and student testimonials on their experience in the Central Film School. The Central Film School offers students a practical education in fictional narrative and documentary filmmaking. We aim to give independent voices the skills and knowledge needed to tell their stories through film.

feeds.title: Filmmakers Academy Blog
feeds.description: Filmmakers Academy blog keeps you up to date with the latest filmmaking news, film production equipment tests and reviews, How-Tos, and more! Filmmakers Academy is a networking hub and educational platform for all things filmmaking. We're a resource for filmmakers who want to master their craft, meet like-minded creatives, and grow.

feeds.title: The Los Angeles Film School Blog
feeds.description: Access the Entertainment Industry with articles, Interviews and videos on filmmaking, music, sound, animation and design and learn about entertainment job opportunities, internships, graduation, campus events and other student news for the Los Angeles Film School.

feeds.title: MetFilm School
feeds.description: Here you can see the latest articles from MetFilm School. Since launch in 2003, MetFilm has been committed to educational excellence and deep links into industry. Our mission is to inspire a new generation of creative screen professionals, educating them in the new world of storytelling across multiple devices.

feeds.title: American Film Institute
feeds.description: AFI Movie Club is a global, virtual gathering of film fans who love movies, exploring new finds and old favorites. The American Film Institute was founded in 1967 as a national arts organization to train world-class filmmakers and preserve America's film heritage.

feeds.title: UCLA School of TFT
feeds.description: Welcome to the UCLA School of Theater, Film, and Television Newsroom, your source for all Student, Alumni, Faculty, and School related news. The UCLA School of Theater, Film and Television is one of the world's most prominent academic institutions for entertainment and performing arts education.

feeds.title: Diversity in Cinema Academy Blog
feeds.description: Through our diverse range of resources, tutorials, and courses, we will provide a fresh new experience for content creators, filmmakers, screenwriters and actors. Our mission is to challenge the status quo by redefining and advancing the roles of multicultural content creators in contemporary filmed entertainment.

feeds.title: Toronto Film School Blog
feeds.description: Read the most recent news on film, fashion, design, and video game with the Toronto Film School. Toronto Film School offers a fast and effective path to an exciting career in film, television, theatre, fashion, graphic design or video game design.

feeds.title: Documentary Film Academy Blog
feeds.description: The Documentary Film Academy blog teaches you everything you need to learn about documentaries and cinematography. Documentary Film Academy is an affordable, flexible and easy-to-understand, step-by-step, online course that will fast-track you to creating cinematic documentaries.

feeds.title: High Definition Film Academy Blog
feeds.description: The High Definition Film Academy blog provides the recent updates in the film academy with regards to their courses, events, masterclasses, and more. High Definition Film Academy was established in 2011 to frontier quality and affordable film education for students around the world with a desire to pursue a career in acting or/and filmmaking.

feeds.title: Film Stills Academy Blog
feeds.description: Insights into the life of a Film Stills Photographer. Part photographer, part ninja, part psychologist. Get the latest news here. The Film Stills Academy was founded in 2020 by photographer Nicola Dove, who has worked on films such as No Time To Die, Murder On The Orient Express, The Death of Stalin, and many more over her twenty-year career.

feeds.title: The Independent Film School Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ela Thier and I help screenwriters and filmmakers create the work that they'll be remembered for. As I was a filmmaker, I began teaching what I was learning. I kept gaining students through word-of-mouth and eventually started The Independent Film School.

feeds.title: Magnus Film Academy Blog
feeds.description: Keep updated with our activities and what is happening in the film industry and the media world by visiting our blog. Magnus Film Academy is the best film school in Enugu, South Eastern Nigeria. We are a film institute firmly grounded in all the technical crafts needed to create digital content.

feeds.title: KAP Film & Television Academy Blog
feeds.description: View the latest blogs from KAP Film & Television Academy and get to know their latest works. Founded by Kunle Afolayan, one of Nigeria's foremost film makers, KAP Film & Television Academy is a film production learning institution offering both offline and online courses in a wide array of filmmaking courses.

feeds.title: New York Film Academy Blog
feeds.description: Check out the New York Film Academy blog for updates on film, entertainment, visual arts, and student life. The New York Film Academy was founded by veteran producer Jerry Sherlock in 1992. NYFA provides students with the tools and know-how, and they apply what they learn in class in the real world, making for an educational experience unlike any other.

feeds.title: InFocus Film School Blog
feeds.description: Visit the InFocus blog to learn about filmmaking and how to start your own filmmaking career. InFocus Film School is an independent film school built on the premise of providing an accelerated education in film and entertainment arts.
